description: Import an article written outside Frase as an ARTICLE IN THE APP, scored and optimizable — not a CMS post (for that use write_cms_post). Frase does not generate it. Supply body (markdown or HTML) or source_url, not both. Costs one article credit. Returns the content id and editor URL; set target_keywords or the SEO score is capped.

body.description: Article body. Set body_format to say which syntax.

source_url.description: Fetch the article from this URL instead of passing body.

target_keywords.description: Keywords to score against. Index 0 is primary.

name: import_content
